inputs.model.prompt:
Use @asset_1 as a reference character. A young person with curly auburn hair floats underwater, eyes gently closed, 
expression weightless and serene. Prismatic light refractions drift and morph 
across their face in slow waves — shifting between teal, peach, and white — 
as the camera glides gently around them in a slow orbital move. 
Caustic light patterns ripple continuously across skin and hair. 
The water carries a soft teal glow; bubbles rise in lazy clusters. 
Shallow depth of field, soft film grain, dreamlike stillness, 
slow motion, 4K, pastel-teal color grade.
